name: Download File
description: Download a file. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/manage-downloads) for more information

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: filePath
configurable_props.label: Destination File Path
configurable_props.description: The destination file name or path [in the `/tmp` directory](https://pipedream.com/docs/workflows/steps/code/nodejs/working-with-files/#the-tmp-directory) (e.g., `/tmp/myFile.csv`)

configurable_props.name: mimeType
configurable_props.label: Conversion Format
configurable_props.description: The format to which to convert the downloaded file if it is a [Google Workspace document](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/ref-export-formats)

configurable_props.name: getBufferResponse
configurable_props.label: Get Buffer Response
configurable_props.description: Whether to return the file content as a buffer instead of writing to a file path
